scripts.gen:client: cargo run -p keepsake-server --bin gen-openapi && pnpm --filter @keepsake/client generate
scripts.build: pnpm gen:client && cargo build --release -p keepsake-server -p keepsake-cli --bins && pnpm --filter @keepsake/web build
scripts.check: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && pnpm --filter @keepsake/web check
